description.content:
Upload and create a new Helm chart package in the project repository. The chart package should be provided as a .tgz file using multipart/form-data with the field name 'chart'.

**Example Request using curl:**
```bash
curl -X POST \
  -H "X-API-KEY: your-api-key" \
  -F "chart=@nginx-chart-1.0.0.tgz" \
  https://api.zededa.com/api/v1/cluster/instances/kubernetes/helm/charts
```

description.content:
Delete a Helm chart from the project repository. This action is irreversible and will remove all versions of the specified chart.

**Example Request:**
```
DELETE /v1/cluster/instances/kubernetes/helm/charts/name/nginx
```

**Example Response:**
```json
{
  "operationType": "OPS_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED",
  "operationStatus": "OPS_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED",
  "objectKind": "",
  "objectId": "4495fb8b-187e-4fc1-8c28-6a8ac6629833",
  "objectName": "nginx",
  "objectRevision": "",
  "objectType": "OBJECT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED",
  "operationTime": "",
  "startTime": "",
  "endTime": "",
  "user": "",
  "httpStatusCode": 200,
  "httpStatusMsg": "",
  "jobId": "",
  "error": [
    {
      "ec": "zMsgSucess",
      "location": "",
      "details": ""
    }
  ]
}
```

**Warning:** This operation will delete ALL versions of the specified chart. If you need to delete a specific version, use the update operation to remove that version from the repository.

**Note:** The chart_name parameter is **required** and must be a valid chart name in the repository.

description.content:
Update an existing Helm chart with a new chart package. The chart name and version must match the existing chart being updated. The chart package should be provided as a .tgz file using multipart/form-data with the field name 'chart'.

**Example Request using curl:**
```bash
curl -X PUT \
  -H "X-API-KEY: your-api-key" \
  -F "chart=@nginx-chart-1.0.1.tgz" \
  https://api.zededa.com/api/v1/cluster/instances/kubernetes/helm/charts/name/nginx/version/1.0.0
```

**Example Response:**
```json
{
  "operationType": "OPS_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED",
  "operationStatus": "OPS_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED",
  "objectKind": "",
  "objectId": "4495fb8b-187e-4fc1-8c28-6a8ac6629833",
  "objectName": "nginx-chart",
  "objectRevision": "",
  "objectType": "OBJECT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED",
  "operationTime": "",
  "startTime": "",
  "endTime": "",
  "user": "",
  "httpStatusCode": 200,

  "jobId": "",
  "error": [
    {
      "ec": "zMsgSucess",
      "location": "",
      "details": ""
    }
  ]
}
```

**Note:** Both chart_name and chart_version path parameters are **required** and must match an existing chart.
